paragraphs: Yose ben Gilai, a Tanna of the Tosefta.

Tosefta Kilayim, chapter 3, relates an incident: they asked Rabban Gamliel, who told them, “Go and ask Yose ben Gilai, who is knowledgeable and expert in the laws of vineyard mixtures.” They went and asked him.

notes.text: The compressed ושאלוה is read in its context as asking Yose. It does not establish an additional female addressee. Vineyard-mixture expertise is the stated reason for consulting him.
